name: Governance Check After Task
description: After spec task completion, verifies architecture compliance, governance artifacts, commit conventions, and DoD criteria.

then.prompt:
Check .compliance-state.json → currentPhase. Apply phase-appropriate rules only.

A spec task was just completed. Run these compliance checks. Each numbered check names the rule ID it enforces; log that ID in the event below:

1. ARCHITECTURE COMPLIANCE [ARCH-01]: Verify code follows architecture-principles.md — no violations of stated principles.
2. LAYER ISOLATION [DOM-05]: If domain layer code was touched, verify no infrastructure dependencies.
3. MODULE BOUNDARIES [MOD-02]: Verify no cross-module direct references were introduced.
4. API CONTRACT ALIGNMENT [GOV-API-001]: If endpoints were created/modified, verify they match the API contract.
5. DEFINITION OF DONE [GOV-SESSION-012]: Check against DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md criteria applicable to this task.
6. COMMIT CONVENTION [GOV-SESSION-003]: Verify commits follow the stated convention from git-workflow.md.

Also enforces the current phase's PG-* gate rules where applicable.

Report findings as:
- ✅ Passing rules (silent if all pass)
- ⚠️ Warnings (non-critical gaps)
- ❌ Violations (critical rules broken — fix before PR)

If all rules pass, confirm compliance silently.

## Compliance Logging
After completing all checks above, append a JSON event to `compliance-log/events/{today-date}.jsonl` (create the file if it doesn't exist) — ONE event per rule checked, and `ruleId` MUST be the actual rule ID from the check above, NEVER a literal placeholder. Format:
{"timestamp": "{ISO-8601-UTC}", "type": "check", "id": "chk-{date}-{time}-{seq}", "hook": "post-task-governance", "trigger": "postTaskExecution", "ruleId": "{the ID from the checked rule, e.g. ARCH-01}", "ruleSeverity": "{severity}", "result": "{pass|fail|warn}", "message": "{one-line-finding}"}
Log ONE event per rule checked.
